info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Langite Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API enables the creation and management of Langite drill detail records in the catalog. It allows users to submit new drill specifications, enhancing the catalog's offerings. Ideal for developers working in equipment management and inventory systems, this API facilitates seamless integration for adding detailed information about Langite drills. Typical use cases include updating inventory databases or automating equipment specifications entry for improved operational efficiency.

post.summary: Create a new detail for the Langite drill.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail entry for the Langite drill, providing essential information regarding its specifications and features. Ensure all required fields are properly populated in the request body to successfully create the detail.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send details for the Langite drill operation. It should include all necessary parameters that specify the drill's operational characteristics and specifications.

200.description: Request completed successfully and returned the expected data.

langite_drill_id.description: The unique identifier for the Langite drill.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of Langite drills requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is of priority status.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Langite drill.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the Langite drill.

warehouseCodes.description: An array of warehouse codes where the drills can be found.

items.description: A unique code representing the warehouse.

CreateCatalogLangiteDrillDetailRequest.description: Request body for creating a new operation for Langite drills.

width.description: The width dimension of the Langite drill.

height.description: The height dimension of the Langite drill.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the dimensions (e.g., cm, m).

Dimensions.description: The dimensions object representing width, height, and unit of measurements.

CreateCatalogLangiteDrillDetailResponse_.title: Operation Response

recordId.description: Unique identifier for the record created or processed.

processedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The count of records that matched the operation criteria.

pricing.description: Pricing details associated with the operation.

CreateCatalogLangiteDrillDetailResponse_.description: Response schema for the operations POST request, containing the status, record identification, processing time, and pricing details.

PricingDetails.title: Pricing Details

currency.description: The currency in which the price is denominated.

taxIncluded.description: Indicates whether the price includes tax.

PricingDetails.description: Contains pricing information including net amount, currency type, and tax inclusion status.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource returned in the response.

x-processing-time.description: Represents the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
